units.source_text: 承香殿女御的哥哥髭黑右大将，本来装得道貌岸然，一本正经，

en.t: The Shokyoden Consort's elder brother, the Right Captain Higekuro, had originally put on an air of moral uprightness and solemn propriety,

units.source_text: 现在也学谚语所谓“爬上恋爱山，孔子也跌倒”，苦苦地向玉鬘求爱了。

en.t: but now, just as the proverb says, "climb the mountain of love, and even Confucius will stumble," he too was painfully pressing his suit to Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得此事另有一种趣味。

en.t: Genji felt that there was a different sort of interest in this affair.

units.source_text: 他查看一切情书，发现有一封信，

en.t: He looked through all the love letters and found one letter,

units.source_text: 写在宝蓝色中国纸上，香气浓烈，沁人心肺，

en.t: written on deep blue Chinese paper, with a rich fragrance that seemed to sink into the heart and lungs,

units.source_text: 摺叠得非常小巧，怪道：“这封信为何摺叠得这样好？”

en.t: folded very small and neat, so that he wondered, "Why has this letter been folded so beautifully?"

units.source_text: 便把信打开，但见笔迹非常秀美，内有诗云：

en.t: He then opened the letter and saw that the handwriting was exceedingly elegant; inside was a poem that read:
